## 环境与初始材料
非root隔离Linux、Python3和OpenSSL标准工具。提供task.py骨架；可信验收生成临时CA、证书和工作区素材，只使用本题文件和回环高端口，不修改系统信任库或公网。

## 操作任务
实现execute(host,port,tls_name,ca_file,query)，host仅数字回环地址，port为1024～65535整数。使用提供CA验证TLS证书与tls_name，不跳过主机名验证；query为12～65535字节DNS查询（QR=0）。经TLS发送两字节网络序长度和原始查询，精确读取分片的响应长度与响应体，检查事务ID、QR=1、TC=0，返回原始DNS响应。建连、握手、发送和读取共享1秒总截止时间；错误证书必须在发送DNS查询前失败，短帧/错误ID/错误标志拒绝，全部连接关闭。这只证明DNS over TLS链路与身份验证，不能据此宣称DNSSEC签名有效，也不是DoH。

## 提交产物
task.py完整实现及任务约定的运行产物。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py启动真实回环TLS服务，核对长度帧/随机ID、响应拆包、错域名/未知CA不泄露查询、短帧/标志错误和持续分片总期限。 全部断言通过退出0；初始骨架及典型错误必须失败，工具未就绪属于环境待验。

失败示例：把TLS改为不验证证书后，加密连接仍会向冒名解析器发送查询；真实错误域名和未知CA反例必须失败。

topic: 生成并验证CRL撤销工件，区分过期与证书撤销
title: 生成并验证CRL撤销工件，区分过期与证书撤销
answer:
```python
import pathlib,tempfile,shutil,subprocess,json,hashlib,os
def execute(ca_dir,revoked_cert,outdir):
    root=pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve();ca=pathlib.Path(ca_dir).resolve();cert=pathlib.Path(revoked_cert).resolve();out=pathlib.Path(outdir).resolve()
    if not all(p.is_relative_to(root) for p in (ca,cert,out)) or out.is_relative_to(ca) or out==root:raise ValueError('isolated workspace paths required')
    if out.exists():raise FileExistsError(out)
    def run(*args):return subprocess.run(['openssl',*map(str,args)],capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=5).stdout
    run('verify','-CAfile',ca/'ca.crt','-purpose','sslserver',cert)
    serial=run('x509','-in',cert,'-noout','-serial').decode().strip().split('=',1)[1].upper()
    matches=[line.split('\t') for line in (ca/'index.txt').read_text().splitlines() if len(line.split('\t'))==6 and int(line.split('\t')[3],16)==int(serial,16)]
    if len(matches)!=1 or matches[0][0]!='V':raise ValueError('one issued valid index entry required')
    stage=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.revoke-',dir=out.parent))
    try:
        working=stage/'authority';shutil.copytree(ca,working)
        config=stage/'openssl.cnf'
        config.write_text('[ca]\ndefault_ca=authority\n[authority]\ndatabase='+str(working/'index.txt')+'\nprivate_key='+str(working/'ca.key')+'\ncertificate='+str(working/'ca.crt')+'\ncrlnumber='+str(working/'crlnumber')+'\ndefault_md=sha256\ndefault_crl_days=1\n')
        run('ca','-batch','-config',config,'-revoke',cert,'-crl_reason','keyCompromise')
        bundle=stage/'bundle';bundle.mkdir();crl=bundle/'revocations.pem'
        run('ca','-batch','-config',config,'-gencrl','-out',crl)
        run('crl','-in',crl,'-CAfile',ca/'ca.crt','-verify','-noout')
        report={'revoked_serial':serial,'reason':'keyCompromise','crl_sha256':hashlib.sha256(crl.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        (bundle/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
        os.replace(bundle,out);return report
    finally:shutil.rmtree(stage)
```

实现execute(ca_dir,revoked_cert,outdir)。ca_dir提供ca.crt/ca.key/index.txt/crlnumber等本题测试CA素材，revoked_cert为其已登记且状态V的服务器证书。用原生OpenSSL验证发行链与服务器用途，复制CA状态到临时区，仅在副本撤销目标证书，原因为keyCompromise；生成并验证CA签名CRL。交付新目录只含revocations.pem、report.json，报告revoked_serial为证书十六进制序列号大写、reason和CRL文件SHA256；返回同一报告。原CA目录字节不变，不交付私钥或内部数据库；输出必须在工作区且不能位于CA目录内，已有输出拒绝且保留。证书未登记、状态非V或原生签名失败不得发布半成品，清理临时目录。验证时两张证书均在有效期内且域名相同，只有被撤销证书被crl_check拒绝。这里只生成离线撤销发布工件，不证明公网客户端已下载CRL，也不更改生产CA。

原理说明（保留原题）：
还可能是颁发链不受信任、缺少中间证书、用途/策略不符、客户端时钟异常、撤销策略或协商参数不兼容。应读具体错误并分别检查链、SAN、信任库和运行时。不能以浏览器绿色图标推断所有 Java、容器和代理都使用相同信任库。

import pathlib,subprocess,sys,json,hashlib,shutil,os,secrets
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
import task
ROOT=pathlib.Path.cwd();ca=ROOT/'authority';ca.mkdir();(ca/'newcerts').mkdir()
(ca/'index.txt').write_text('');(ca/'serial').write_text('10'+secrets.token_hex(7)+'\n');(ca/'crlnumber').write_text('2000\n')
def command(*args,check=True):return subprocess.run(['openssl',*map(str,args)],capture_output=True,check=check,timeout=5)
command('req','-x509','-newkey','ec','-pkeyopt','ec_paramgen_curve:P-256','-nodes','-keyout',ca/'ca.key','-out',ca/'ca.crt','-days','1','-subj','/CN=Revocation Test CA')
config=ROOT/'ca.cnf';config.write_text('[ca]\ndefault_ca=authority\n[authority]\ndatabase='+str(ca/'index.txt')+'\nnew_certs_dir='+str(ca/'newcerts')+'\nserial='+str(ca/'serial')+'\nprivate_key='+str(ca/'ca.key')+'\ncertificate='+str(ca/'ca.crt')+'\ndefault_md=sha256\ndefault_days=1\npolicy=names\nx509_extensions=leaf\n[names]\ncommonName=supplied\n[leaf]\nbasicConstraints=CA:FALSE\nkeyUsage=digitalSignature\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\nsubjectAltName=DNS:lab.test\n')
for name in ['compromised','healthy']:
    command('req','-new','-newkey','ec','-pkeyopt','ec_paramgen_curve:P-256','-nodes','-keyout',name+'.key','-out',name+'.csr','-subj','/CN='+name)
    command('ca','-batch','-config',config,'-in',name+'.csr','-out',name+'.crt','-notext')
def snapshot(directory):return {str(p.relative_to(directory)):p.read_bytes() for p in directory.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
before=snapshot(ca)
for cert in ['compromised.crt','healthy.crt']:
    command('verify','-CAfile',ca/'ca.crt','-verify_hostname','lab.test',cert)
    command('x509','-in',cert,'-checkend','60','-noout')
result=task.execute(ca,'compromised.crt','revocation-bundle');out=ROOT/'revocation-bundle'
assert set(p.name for p in out.iterdir())=={'revocations.pem','report.json'},'do not publish private CA key or staging database'
serial=command('x509','-in','compromised.crt','-noout','-serial').stdout.decode().strip().split('=',1)[1].upper()
assert result==json.loads((out/'report.json').read_text())=={'revoked_serial':serial,'reason':'keyCompromise','crl_sha256':hashlib.sha256((out/'revocations.pem').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
command('crl','-in',out/'revocations.pem','-CAfile',ca/'ca.crt','-verify','-noout')
bad=command('verify','-CAfile',ca/'ca.crt','-CRLfile',out/'revocations.pem','-crl_check','compromised.crt',check=False)
assert bad.returncode!=0 and b'certificate revoked' in bad.stderr,(bad.returncode,bad.stderr)
command('verify','-CAfile',ca/'ca.crt','-CRLfile',out/'revocations.pem','-crl_check','healthy.crt')
text=command('crl','-in',out/'revocations.pem','-text','-noout').stdout
assert b'Key Compromise' in text
assert snapshot(ca)==before,'original CA state mutated'
assert not list(ROOT.glob('.revoke-*'))
saved=snapshot(out)
try:task.execute(ca,'healthy.crt',out)
except FileExistsError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('existing output overwritten')
assert snapshot(out)==saved
# A signed certificate absent from the issuance index must not be silently added.
command('x509','-req','-in','healthy.csr','-CA',ca/'ca.crt','-CAkey',ca/'ca.key','-set_serial','0xABCD','-days','1','-out','unregistered.crt')
try:task.execute(ca,'unregistered.crt','unregistered-output')
except (ValueError,subprocess.CalledProcessError):pass
else:raise AssertionError('unregistered certificate accepted')
assert not pathlib.Path('unregistered-output').exists() and snapshot(ca)==before
inactive=ROOT/'inactive-authority';shutil.copytree(ca,inactive)
(inactive/'index.txt').write_text((inactive/'index.txt').read_text().replace('V\t','E\t'))
try:task.execute(inactive,'healthy.crt','inactive-output')
except ValueError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('non-valid index entry accepted')
assert not pathlib.Path('inactive-output').exists() and snapshot(ca)==before
for target in [ca/'forbidden',ROOT.parent/'outside-revocation']:
    try:task.execute(ca,'healthy.crt',target)
    except ValueError:pass
    else:raise AssertionError('unsafe output path accepted')
    assert not target.exists()
# Native signing failure must remove staged material and never publish a partial bundle.
broken=ROOT/'broken-authority';shutil.copytree(ca,broken);(broken/'ca.key').write_text('not a private key')
try:task.execute(broken,'healthy.crt','failed-output')
except subprocess.CalledProcessError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('signing failure ignored')
assert not pathlib.Path('failed-output').exists() and not list(ROOT.glob('.revoke-*'))
assert snapshot(ca)==before
